journal_lines: Blaze near the magma. Heat radiating.
Fire and spinning rods. Kept moving.
It found me first. That's fine.
Charged through the smoke. Worth it.
The heat warps the air around it. Hard to track.
Came through the smoke from behind.
Two blazes patrolling the same corridor. Took one at a time.
Fireball above, fireball below. Found the gap.
The platform it was on gave it height. Denied it the height.
It was floating. That's inconvenient. Managed.
Burning charge. Got under the fireballs.
Fire everywhere. Moved toward the fire quickly to end it.
It found me first. Decided to find it back.
The smoke screen worked against it.
First blaze today. Third encounter total.
